registryEntry.set_command: $created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations' -Body (@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.windows10GeneralConfiguration';displayName='CMMC-Defender-TrafficMonitoring';description='CMMC L2: Defender network inspection of device traffic, real-time monitoring, incoming mail and download scanning';defenderRequireNetworkInspectionSystem=$true;defenderRequireRealTimeMonitoring=$true;defenderScanIncomingMail=$true;defenderScanDownloads=$true;defenderMonitorFileActivity='monitorAllFiles'} | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType 'application/json'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations/$($created.id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.groupAssignmentTarget';groupId='{cuiGroupId}'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
